run_plot_eval_bars_minigrid: run plot_eval_bars.py to generate bar charts comparing RL methods across MiniGrid environments from CSV result files
run_plot_eval_bars_bipedal: run plot_eval_bars.py to plot BipedalWalker evaluation results as grouped bar charts with error bars
run_plot_eval_bars_custom_metrics: run plot_eval_bars.py with custom row_prefix and include filters to plot specific metrics from result CSVs
run_parse_args: run parse_args to configure result path, CSV files, labels, ylabel, savename, and figsize for bar chart generation
run_plot_eval_bars_uniform_blocks: run plot_eval_bars.py with custom figsize to plot uniform block count results across environments
